before.label: Core profile
before.description: Record visible structure; the image is evidence, not a proof of ancient life.

after.label: Core layer photograph
after.description: Photograph the visible layers in the actual ice core. The photograph records their order, not calibrated dimensions, a shared age with another site, or evidence of life.

before.label: Layer interpretation
before.description: The earlier profile records layers in an ice exposure; this core records sediment at another site. Here, grain sizes differ from one layer to the next. Comparing the records does not establish a shared age or cause.

after.label: Fine–coarse–fine layers
after.description: The earlier photograph records layers in ice; the basin core records sediment at another site. Here, grain sizes differ between layers. Comparing these records does not establish a shared age or cause.

before.label: Basin field record
before.description: This fictional mission record preserves a coarse band between two fine-grained layers at the core site. Grain sizes and layer order are recorded; age and transport agent remain unresolved. Nearby exposures may help test a water-transport explanation.

reading.text: At this core site, a coarse band separates two fine-grained layers. We kept a labelled specimen. The saved ice profile is a comparison, not proof that the two places share an age or history. Nearby exposures may help us interpret the change.
reading.attribution: Fictional expedition field note; not a real mission measurement.

after.label: Basin field record
